Χαίρομαι που άκουσα, και ακόμη συμμετείχα, σε συζητήσεις για το εμβόλιο Covid—γιατί ο ένας το έχει κάνει και γιατί ο άλλος όχι. Τολμώ να πω ότι θα μπορούσαμε να έχουμε επτά άτομα να εκφράσουν την άποψή τους και ίσως να έχουμε οκτώ διαφορετικές ιδέες.

Ξεκινώ με την αποποίηση ότι αυτές είναι οι σκέψεις μου, και είμαι απολύτως εντάξει αν κάποιος διαφωνεί. Στην πραγματικότητα, θα καλωσόριζα άλλους να μοιραστούν τις απόψεις τους.

Ένα από τα πράγματα που θα παρατηρήσετε σε αυτό το γραπτό είναι ότι δεν αποκαλώ το εμβόλιο Covid «εμβόλιο». Όχι ότι δεν ταιριάζει τεχνικά με τον επίσημο ορισμό, αλλά μάλλον ότι δεν λειτουργεί όπως ξέραμε τα εμβόλια να λειτουργούν. Θυμάμαι όταν ήμουν παιδί περίπου τεσσάρων ετών, πήγα με τη μητέρα μου στο υγειονομικό τμήμα και έλαβα ένα εμβόλιο στο πάνω μέρος του βραχίονα για την ευλογιά. (Το σημάδι είναι ακόμα εκεί) Θυμάμαι μερικά χρόνια αργότερα όταν όλη η κοινότητα μαζεύτηκε στο τοπικό δημόσιο σχολείο για τη θεραπεία με κύβους ζάχαρης που ήταν ένα στοματικό εμβόλιο κατά της πολιομυελίτιδας. Δεν θυμάμαι αν είχα άλλα εμβόλια ή όχι. Το σημείο μου είναι ότι αυτά τα εμβόλια ήταν ανοσοποιήσεις κατά μίας νόσου. Μας διαβεβαίωσαν ότι δεν θα κολλούσαμε ευλογιά, πολιομυελίτιδα, ιλαρά ή ό,τι άλλο εμβολιαστήκαμε γι’ αυτό. Και δεν κολλούσαμε—όχι απλώς λιγότερο ή μια περίπτωση όχι τόσο σοβαρή. Καταλαβαίναμε ότι είχαμε ανοσοποιηθεί, και ο αγώνας είχε τελειώσει.

Κατά τη διάρκεια της τρέχουσας πανδημίας συνεχίζαμε να ακούμε για το εμβόλιο που ερχόταν. Φαινόταν ότι αυτό θα ήταν η απάντηση στην πανώλη που είχε καθίσει πάνω στον κόσμο. Κάποιοι από εμάς αναρωτήθηκαν αν αυτό θα ήταν σαν το αντιγριπικό εμβόλιο που στοχεύει ορισμένους ιούς, ενώ χάνει άλλους ιούς της γρίπης. Καθώς η υπόθεση εξελισσόταν, σύντομα αρχίσαμε να ακούμε για παραλλαγές και την ανάγκη για ενισχυτικές δόσεις. Τώρα γνωρίζουμε με βεβαιότητα ότι αυτό το εμβόλιο δεν δίνει ανοσοποίηση για το Covid‑19, και επομένως, για σαφήνεια είναι καλύτερο να το αποκαλούμε αντιγριπικό εμβόλιο.

Θυμάμαι τόσο καλά τη γεωργία στις αρχές της δεκαετίας του ’90 και την ακοή για καλλιέργειες «Roundup‑Ready». Φαινόταν πολύ καλό για να είναι αληθινό το να μπορείς να ψεκάζεις γλυφοσάτη (Roundup) πάνω από την καλλιέργεια και να εξαφανίζεις όλα τα ζιζάνια χωρίς να βλάπτεις την καλλιέργεια. Ο κατασκευαστής συνέχιζε να μας λέει να ψεκάζουμε στις μέγιστες δόσεις ώστε να «σκοτώσουμε» κάθε ζιζάνιο. Θεωρητικά είχαν δίκιο, αν μπορούσαμε να σκοτώσουμε κάθε ζιζάνιο, χωρίς να χάσουμε ούτε ένα, δεν θα είχαμε το επόμενο πρόβλημα—τα ζιζάνια ανθεκτικά στον ψεκασμό. Δεν συνειδητοποιήσαμε πόσο γρήγορα τα ενοχλητικά μας «pigweeds» (και άλλα ζιζάνια) στο νότο, θα μεταλλάσσονταν και θα ανέπτυσσαν ανθεκτικότητα στη γλυφοσάτη.

Φυσικά, οι αγρότες είχαν μερικά καλά χρόνια με έναν εύκολο τρόπο να κρατούν τα ζιζάνια εκτός, αλλά αυτό δεν κράτησε και τώρα η κατάσταση είναι χειρότερη από ό,τι ήταν πριν. Σήμερα, κάθε αγρότης γνωρίζει για το «Palmer amaranth Pigweed». Μπορείς σχεδόν να «αδειάσεις» γλυφοσάτη πάνω του, και παρ’ όλα αυτά ευδοκιμεί. Αυτά τα ζιζάνια μεταλλάχθηκαν πολύ γρήγορα και έγιναν ανθεκτικά.

Νομίζω ότι έχουμε ένα παρόμοιο σενάριο με το εμβόλιο Covid. Σίγουρα δεν είμαι επιστήμονας αλλά μου φαίνεται ότι αφού το εμβόλιο αποδεδειγμένα κυρίως μειώνει τα συμπτώματα αντί να παράγει ανοσία, τότε πολύ πιθανόν θα επιταχύνει τη μετάλλαξη του ιού Covid‑19. Αυτό μοιάζει με την κανονική αρχή του «αγώνα για την επιβίωση» της ζωής.

Η ταχύτητα με την οποία αυτό το εμβόλιο βγήκε στην αγορά είναι άλλη μια ανησυχία. Πραγματικά δεν ξέρουμε τι θα φέρει στο μέλλον ούτε τις παρενέργειες που μπορεί να προκαλέσει. Δεν ξέρουμε πόσες ενισχυτικές δόσεις θα απαιτηθούν. Φαίνεται ο κόσμος να είναι το πεδίο δοκιμής αυτή τη στιγμή, και από ό,τι βλέπω δεν λειτουργεί τόσο καλά και πολλοί από τους ανθρώπους που έχουν κάνει το εμβόλιο δεν το εμπιστεύονται πραγματικά. Οι άνθρωποι που κόλλησαν τον ιό έχουν αναπτύξει μια ανοσία που είναι πολύ ανώτερη από την προστασία του εμβολίου. Ξέραμε από την παιδική ηλικία ότι όταν κολλάγαμε γρίπη, το σώμα μας θα ανέπτυσσε ανοσία σε εκείνο το στέλεχος. Έτσι μας δημιούργησε ο Δημιουργός μας. Ένα από τα πρώτα πρόσωπα που εγώ προσωπικά γνώριζα ότι είχε Covid του είπαν ότι θα έχει έξι μήνες ανοσίας. Αναρωτήθηκα πώς το βρήκαν τόσο γρήγορα. Αυτός ήταν ένας νέος ιός, και δεν είχαμε εμπειρία για να στηριχτούμε σε σχέση με αυτόν τον ιό. Επίσης, οι ιοί που γνωρίζαμε έδιναν δια βίου ανοσία σε εκείνο το στέλεχος. Ποια επιστήμη στήριζε λοιπόν αυτό;

Επομένως, νομίζω είναι πολύ καλύτερο να λάβουμε προφυλάξεις και να κάνουμε ό,τι μπορούμε για να ενισχύσουμε το ανοσοποιητικό μας σύστημα. Είναι εξαιρετική στιγμή να θυμηθούμε ότι πρέπει να είμαστε οικονόμοι του σώματος που μας έδωσε ο Θεός. Είναι καλή στιγμή να καταρτίσουμε ένα σχέδιο καλής διατροφής, άσκησης και απώλειας βάρους. Εάν είστε υπέρβαροι, είναι πολύ πιο πιθανό να επηρεαστείτε από αυτή την πανώλη και από πολλές άλλες ασθένειες. Εάν καταναλώνετε τακτικά αναψυκτικά με ζάχαρη ή ανθυγιεινά τρόφιμα οποιουδήποτε είδους, είναι εξαιρετική στιγμή να κόψετε τη συνήθεια και να μειώσετε την κατανάλωση ζάχαρης. Εάν είστε υπέρβαροι ή εκτός φόρμας σωματικά, δεν υπάρχει καλύτερη στιγμή από τώρα να φέρετε το σώμα σας σε μια κατάσταση πολύ πιο υγιή, έτσι ώστε να είστε σε θέση να αποκρούσετε καλύτερα αυτόν τον ιό και πολλές άλλες ασθένειες.

Πιστεύω ότι μακροπρόθεσμα θα είναι ασφαλέστερο και καλύτερο να κάνω το μέρος μου και να αφήσω αυτό το σώμα να χτίσει τις ανοσίες για να προστατεύσει τον εαυτό του από αυτόν τον ιό. Συνειδητοποιώ ότι υπάρχουν εκείνοι που πέθαναν αφού προσβλήθηκαν από αυτή την ασθένεια. Δεν υποτιμώ αυτό το γεγονός και λυπάμαι για την απώλεια ζωής. Πιστεύω επίσης ότι εμείς ως Χριστιανοί πρέπει συνεχώς να εμπιστευόμαστε τη ζωή μας στον Θεό και να εξετάζουμε το συνολικό πλαίσιο της ζωής και της διατήρησής της μέσω του πρίσματος της χριστιανικής ηθικής.

Είναι πρωτοφανές ότι μια ασθένεια με ποσοστό ανάρρωσης κάπου γύρω στο 99% να προκαλέσει τέτοιο αναβρασμό σε όλο τον κόσμο. Ξέρουμε ότι αν δεν ήταν για την εφεύρεση των μέσων κοινωνικής δικτύωσης, δεν θα υπήρχε σχεδόν η ίδια πανικός και αναταραχή. Μία από τις μεγαλύτερες ανησυχίες μου είναι πώς «εκπαιδευόμαστε» για περισσότερα που θα ακολουθήσουν. Ποιος θα είχε ποτέ φανταστεί ότι ένας ιός γρίπης θα ήταν το εργαλείο που θα εισήγαγε μια παγκόσμια ώθηση για κάτι που θα ήταν το σημείο αναφοράς για το αν μπορούμε να ταξιδέψουμε, να πάμε σε εστιατόρια, να συγκεντρωθούμε για δημόσιες εκδηλώσεις και άλλους τέτοιους περιορισμούς. Ακούγεται παράξενα παρόμοιο με όσα λέει ο Θεός ότι κάποια μέρα θα είναι πραγματικότητα—Και προστάζει πάντας, τους μικρούς και τους μεγάλους, τους πλούσιους και τους πτωχούς, τους ελευθέρους και τους δούλους, να λάβουν σφραγίδα στο δεξί τους χέρι ή στα μέτωπά τους: Και ότι κανείς δεν ήταν δυνατόν να αγοράζη ή να πωλήση εάν δεν είχεν τη σφραγίδα, είτε το όνομα του θηρίου είτε τον αριθμό του ονόματός του –Αποκάλυψις 13:16-17.

Έχω σχεδόν δεχτεί χλευασμό επειδή αναφέρω ακόμη και τη σφραγίδα του θηρίου. Άλλοι θεωρούν ότι αυτή η περικοπή πρέπει να πνευματοποιηθεί και δεν έχει τίποτα να κάνει με το σύστημα διακυβέρνησης των εσχάτων. Άλλοι νομίζουν ότι η νύμφη θα αρπαγεί πριν απ’ αυτό, οπότε δεν υπάρχει τίποτα να μας απασχολεί. Ευχόμουν μία από αυτές τις απόψεις να ήταν σωστή, τότε θα μπορούσα να προχωρήσω σιωπηλά ελπίζοντας ότι όλα θα πάνε καλά.

Θα βιαστώ να πω ότι δεν νομίζω πως αυτό είναι η «σφραγίδα του θηρίου», αλλά μάλλον το βλέπω ως ένα ακόμη βήμα πιο κοντά σε εκείνο το γεγονός. Επιπλέον βιάζομαι να πω ότι αυτό δεν είναι ένα κείμενο για να χλευάσω μια άλλη πεποίθηση ούτε είναι μια προσπάθεια να συγκεντρώσω ορισμένα χωρία για να υποστηρίξω μια ειδική δογματική ατζέντα όπως η ιδέα ότι όλοι οι πιστοί θα αρπαγούν πριν την αποκάλυψη των εσχατολογικών γεγονότων, διαφεύγοντας έτσι αυτό που η Αγία Γραφή αναφέρει ως «μεγάλη θλίψη». –Βλ. Ματθαίον 24:21 και Αποκάλυψις 7:14. Είναι καιρός να ανοίξουμε τα μάτια μας στην «εκπαίδευση» που μας επιβάλλει η κοινωνία γενικά, και στην «εκπαίδευση» αυτού του εμβολίου ειδικότερα. Υπάρχουν όλα τα είδη καλών λόγων που θα προτρέπουν την προώθησή του—είναι λογικό, προσβάλλει την επιστήμη να μη το κάνεις, έχω ακούσει ακόμη ότι μπορούμε να γίνουμε καλύτεροι μάρτυρες αν το έχουμε κάνει, και η λίστα συνεχίζεται. Όλο αυτό το διάστημα «εκπαιδευόμαστε» να κάνουμε ό,τι χρειάζεται για να συνεχίσουμε να κυλάμε στον οικονομικό μας δρόμο.

Έτσι, η παράκλησή μου είναι να σκεφτούμε προς τα πού οδεύουμε. Μια μέρα ο λαός του Θεού θα χρειαστεί να πηδήξει από το τρένο αυτού του κόσμου—Διότι διά τούτο βγείτε απ’ αυτά, και ξεχωρίσατε, λέγει ο Κύριος· και αφόμενοι τα ακάθαρτα, θα σας δεχθώ –Β΄ Κορινθίους 6:17. Η Αποκάλυψις 14:10-11 δηλώνει ότι όλοι όσοι πάρουν τη σφραγίδα θα σφραγίσουν τη μοίρα τους στην κόλαση. Το επόμενο εδάφιο δίνει ένα κάλεσμα για την υπομονή των αγίων—Αυτός είναι ο πανοπλισμός των αγίων· αυτοί είνε οι τηρούντες τας εντολάς του Θεού και την πίστιν του Ιησού –Αποκάλυψις 14:12.

Θα υπάρξουν δύσκολες εποχές—Διαβάσατε Ματθαίον 24:4-28. Σκεφτείτε τις λιμοκτονίες, τις επιδημίες και τους σεισμούς που υποσχέθηκε ότι θα έλθουν. Ο Ιησούς είπε ότι όλα αυτά είναι τα αρχόμενα των πόνων—κυριολεκτικά ωδίνες τοκετού. Είπε επίσης μ’ αυτά, «το τέλος δεν είναι ακόμη». Ωστόσο έχουμε την υπόσχεση της νίκης—Και εκείνοι επέρασαν αυτόν διά το αίμα του Αρνίου και διά τον λόγον της μαρτυρίας αυτών· και δεν ηγάπησαν την ψυχήν αυτών μέχρι θανάτου –Αποκάλυψις 12:11. Λέω πάλι, «Μια μέρα οι άγιοι θα χρειαστεί να πηδήξουν από το οικονομικό τρένο.»

Νομίζω ότι τώρα είναι εξαιρετική στιγμή να αξιολογήσουμε την προσκόλλησή μας, είτε συνδέεται με αυτόν τον κόσμο είτε με την μελλοντική ουράνια ανταμοιβή μας. Ας ανανεώσουμε τη δέσμευση να ταυτιστούμε με τον σύντομα ερχόμενο Κύριό μας και Βασιλιά μας. Επίσης, είναι εξαιρετική στιγμή να μοιραστούμε το ευαγγέλιο της Βασιλείας του Ιησού με μια κοινωνία που είναι αποφασισμένη να απομακρυνθεί από τον Δημιουργό.

Έτσι, προς το παρόν, είμαι ικανοποιημένος να νιώθω ασφαλής με την ανοσία στο σώμα μου όπως ο Θεός το δημιούργησε και σκοπεύω με νέο τρόπο να επιδιώξω την ανοσία από τους τρόπους της αμαρτίας και του κακού και να εμβολιαστώ με το Άγιο Πνεύμα από τον ουρανό. Θα με συνδράμετε σε αυτή τη δέσμευση;

Greetings of love in Jesus’ name! We have a great God who is worthy of all our praise, all our love, and our whole life!

We live in a time where there are many distractions. The prince of this world is truly out to destroy people’s lives at whatever cost. We have amusement parks, video arcades, theaters, internet, Facebook, fashion malls, and whatever else you can think of—it’s out there. But God would have our hearts stirred to not be entangled with these distractions, but rather to work for Him and His Kingdom. If we are entangled with the affairs of this life, we will have no time left for our Lord. We cannot serve two masters. There seem to be some things trying to steal the time of our dear sisters (young and old alike). Let us be aware of these things so that we can be free from them and then be free to serve the Lord with our whole hearts.

The one thing we should be aware of is called adornment and the other is foolishness or looseness. To me it is so amazing how God works. He tells us in His Word what not to adorn ourselves with, but He also tells us what to adorn ourselves with. He tells us what fruit should be coming from our lives, and what fruit should not be coming from our lives. For every evil way that there is, God also shows us the right way. I know many of us would not go to fashion malls to buy our clothes, but I fear that many of us are still looking for clothes that accent the body rather than glorify our Lord. Jesus said: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God –Matthew 5:8.

Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel; But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price. For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement –1 Peter 3:3-6.

Adorn: to deck or beautify; set off; to embellish by anything external or adventitious; to display the beauty or excellence of.

Remember, God wants us to adorn ourselves with things that will bring glory to Him. Depending on the type of clothing that I choose to wear, the focus of others is drawn to my clothing first, instead of my countenance. When this happens then I am getting all the glory because the focus is on my apparel. But if somebody sees me and they can see the clear countenance on my face and they can tell that I’ve been with Jesus, then they will give God all the glory that He deserves, and we will be displaying the beauty or excellence of God’s spirit in our lives.

Now let’s take a look at some more of the words found in our Scripture text and consider their meaning:

Plaiting: folding, doubling, braiding.

Apparel: clothing; external habiliments or decorations.

Ornament: That which embellishes; or something which, added to another thing, renders it most beautiful to the eye.

How beautiful it is to our Lord when we become born again, have a broken spirit, and become meek and quiet. Can people see the fruits of God’s spirit in our lives—as ornaments? Truly that is an ornament of great price. Remember we can add external ornaments to our lives that bring sadness to our Father. Let us not make Him ashamed to call us His sons and daughters.

Meek: mild of temper; soft; gentle; not easily provoked or irritated; yielding, given to forbearance under injuries.

Are we irritated if somebody has something to share with us that will help us in our walk with the Lord? Remember our Lord wants the fruit of meekness adorning our converted lives.

Quiet: still; being in a state of rest; not moving; peaceable; not turbulent; not giving offence; not exciting controversy, disorder, or trouble; mild; meek; contented.

With every new style that comes in among us are we quick to change for no reason other than adding something to our bodies that only brings glory to us? Are we content with the biblical standard of God for our lives? Are we firm and grounded in what we believe? Do we know why we believe in what we believe?

Subjection: the act of subduing; the act of vanquishing and bringing under the dominion of another.

Are we under the dominion of our Lord in every aspect of our lives?

Afraid: impressed with fear or apprehension.

Amazement: astonishment; confusion or perplexity from a sudden impression of fear, surprise, or wonder.

We are daughters of Sarah as long as we do well, and are not impressed with fear or any confusion or perplexity. God is not the author of confusion—The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul… –Psalm 19:7. Remember: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom [not confusion]… –Proverbs 9:10.

Entangleth: to twist or interweave in such a manner as not to be easily separated; to perplex or distract, as with cares.

Are we allowing our lives to be interwoven with the fashions and foolishness of this world?

No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier. But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness. Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart –2 Timothy 2:4-22.

Shun: to avoid; to keep clear of; not to fall on or come in contact with; not to mix or associate with.

Are we shunning the practices of this world? More specifically, are we shunning loose and empty talk?

Profane: irreverent to anything sacred; polluted; not pure.

Vain: empty; worthless; having no substance, value, or importance.

What we fill ourselves with will come out. If we are filling ourselves with God’s holy Word, then that will be flowing out of our lives. However, if we are filling ourselves with vain things then that shall come out as well.

Babblings: foolish talk.

Is our talk centered on the Bible, or is it centered on the new things that we have bought such as a new garment or a vehicle, or maybe it’s on all the people we have met on Facebook?

Flee: to run with rapidity, as from danger; to hasten from danger; or expected evil.

If we are with a group of people whose talk is foolish, do we stay for fear of losing friends or do we walk (or run) away from the expected or dangerous evil? The more we interweave our lives with the ways of the world, the harder it is to untangle ourselves.

Lusts: longing desire; eagerness to possess or enjoy; carnal appetite; unlawful desire of carnal pleasure.

God will give us the true desires of our heart. We may say that we desire pure things, but if our heart is yearning for unlawful things, we shall yield to those things. Our lives consist not only in what we say, but more importantly what we live. Also, take courage, the inward desires of our heart can be forever changed through the spiritual operation or “new birth”.

Righteousness: the active and passive obedience of Christ, by which the law of God is fulfilled.

If we are to follow righteousness, then that means we should follow the active and passive obedience that Christ shows us by his example.

Faith: the object of belief; a doctrine or system of doctrines believed.

What is the reality of our faith? Do we really believe God and what He tells us through His written Word? It was because Abraham believed God that he was able to “offer up” his only son Isaac through whom Abraham’s descendants would be counted. –see Hebrews 11:17 and Genesis 22:13. If God tells us in His Word to shun ungodliness because it will lead to more ungodliness, then we need to believe God and flee those things, and we must not allow ourselves to think that just a little bit of fun will not matter.

Charity: love; benevolence; goodwill; that disposition of the heart which inclines men to think favorably of their fellow men, and to do them good; it includes supreme love to God our Maker and universal good will to men.

Do we have the Love of God dwelling within and flowing out of our lives like a spring of running water?

Peace: heavenly rest; harmony; freedom from disturbance or agitation.

We are to follow the example of our dear Savior Jesus Christ whose whole life was in perfect harmony with God the Father. Christ was not disturbed or disrupted by the ways of this world, but He was at rest doing His Father’s will. Are we?

Pure: clear; free from moral defilement; without spot; holy; incorrupt.

We are to follow or have these fruits adorned in our lives and also practicing these with those who are practicing the same things in their own lives. A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array; But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works –1 Timothy 2:9-10.

Shamefacedness: bashfulness; excess of modesty.

We should be adorned with shamefacedness and not giddiness or sensuality.

Sobriety: habitual soberness; seriousness; gravity without sadness or melancholy.

Even if we are sober we don’t need to be sad but we can have the joy of the Lord adorning our lives. There should be a light in our eyes because Jesus is the light of our lives. Truly if God’s spirit is dwelling within us we have so much to be thankful for. It should be evident in every aspect of our lives.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world –Titus 2:11-12.

I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels –Isaiah 61:10.

The ornaments of modesty, shamefacedness, sobriety, faith, charity, peace, righteousness, meekness, and quietness are truly jewels of great price. These jewels are so valuable that it is worth surrendering our whole lives to the God of Heaven, our Maker, and our Redeemer, so that we may have them adorning our lives. But likewise, if we are surrendered to the god of this world we will have the ornaments of pride, envy, hate, jealousy, and so forth. Which ones are the more beautiful?

And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God. –Revelation 21:2-3.

Are we preparing to meet Jesus? Is God dwelling in us? Is He our God and are we His people?

Remember time is swiftly passing by. We can be here today and gone tomorrow. Do we want to be with Jesus throughout all eternity, or do we want to be with the devil and his angels? The choices we make for our lives today will affect where we spend eternity.

Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap –Galatians 6:7. Don’t be misled. That verse is also for the believer, not just for the unconverted. Each one of us can ask ourselves what we are sowing. Concerning adornment, are we sowing the thought that outward beauty is very important or are we sowing the thought that inward beauty is the most precious thing to have and obtain? For clarification, I am not talking about being dirty and unkempt. God is a God of order and cleanliness, but He is not a God of ribbons, bows, frills, lace, and expensive, attractive clothing. Remember that most people who create new clothing fashions focus on designing garments so that they will be appealing and attractive to the eye. That is what makes people buy them.

Again, when people look at us do they glorify our fleshly body or are they praising God for the work that He is doing in our lives? Also, concerning foolishness and looseness, if we are grounded in the word of God, we will not have time for vain babblings and pleasure-seeking idleness. Let us be busy doing the work of our Lord, such as helping our neighbor who could use an extra hand, or sharing our testimony with people that we meet.

And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell –Matthew 10:28. As we live in these last times, the message that is all around us is that as long as you believe in a God, you will be okay. That is a false message. Jesus tells us there is only one way. Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him –John 14:6-7. Praise the Lord that God has given us an example to follow.

Kjærlighetsfulle hilsener i Jesu navn! Vi har en stor Gud som er verdig all vår lovprisning, all vår kjærlighet og hele vårt liv!

Vi lever i en tid med mange forstyrrelser. Denne verdens fyrste er virkelig ute etter å ødelegge menneskers liv for enhver pris. Vi har fornøyelsesparker, spillehaller, teatre, internett, Facebook, kjøpesentre med moteklær og alt annet du kan tenke deg—det finnes der ute. Men Gud ønsker at våre hjerter skal vekk fra å bli innviklet i disse distraksjonene, og i stedet arbeide for Ham og Hans rike. Hvis vi blir innviklet i livets saker, vil vi ikke ha tid igjen for vår Herre. Vi kan ikke tjene to herrer. Det virker som om det finnes noen ting som prøver å stjele tiden til våre kjære søstre (unge og gamle likt). La oss være bevisste på disse tingene, så vi kan bli frie fra dem og dermed frie til å tjene Herren med hele vårt hjerte.

Den ene tingen vi bør være oppmerksomme på kalles pyntelse, og den andre er dårskap eller løsaktighet. For meg er det så forunderlig hvordan Gud virker. Han forteller oss i sitt ord hva vi ikke skal pryde oss med, men Han forteller oss også hva vi skal pryde oss med. Han forteller oss hvilke frukter som bør komme fra våre liv, og hvilke frukter som ikke bør komme fra våre liv. For hver onde vei som finnes, viser Gud oss også den rette veien. Jeg vet at mange av oss ikke ville gå til motekjøpesentre for å kjøpe klær, men jeg frykter at mange av oss fortsatt ser etter klær som fremhever kroppen i stedet for å gi ære til vår Herre. Jesus sa: Salige er de som er rene av hjertet, for de skal se Gud – Matteus 5:8.

La deres pryd ikke være det ytre, slik som fletter i håret og smykker av gull eller klær; men la det være det skjulte menneske i hjertet, det som ikke er forgjengelig, pyntet med en mild og stille ånd, som er av stort verdi i Guds øyne. For på samme måte prydet også i gamle tider de hellige kvinnene seg som satte sitt håp til Gud, idet de var underdanige mot sine menn; likesom Sara adlød Abraham og kalte ham herre. Dere er hennes døtre så lenge dere gjør godt og ikke frykter for noe skremmende – 1 Petter 3:3-6.

Pryd: å pynte eller gjøre vakker; framheve; å utsmykke med noe ytre eller tilstøtende; å vise fram skjønnheten eller fortreffeligheten til.

Husk, Gud ønsker at vi skal pryde oss med ting som vil bringe ære til Ham. Avhengig av hvilken type klær jeg velger å bære, blir andres oppmerksomhet først trukket mot mitt tøy i stedet for mitt ansikt. Når dette skjer, får jeg all ære fordi fokuset er på mitt antrekk. Men hvis noen ser meg og kan se det klare uttrykket i mitt ansikt og de kan se at jeg har vært hos Jesus, da vil de gi Gud all den ære Han fortjener, og vi vil vise skjønnheten eller fortreffeligheten av Guds ånd i våre liv.

Nå la oss se på noen flere av ordene i vår bibeltekst og vurdere deres betydning:

Plaiting: å brette, doble, flette.

Apparel: klær; ytre bekledning eller dekorasjoner.

Ornament: Det som utsmykker; eller noe som, lagt til en annen ting, gjør det vakrest for øyet.

Hvor vakkert er det ikke for vår Herre når vi blir født på ny, får en knust ånd og blir milde og stille. Kan folk se fruktene av Guds ånd i våre liv—som prydelser? Virkelig, det er en prydelse av stor verdi. Husk at vi kan legge til ytre prydelser i vårt liv som bringer sorg over vår Far. La oss ikke gjøre Ham skamfull for å kalle oss Hans sønner og døtre.

Meek: mild i temperament; myk; øm; ikke lett provosert eller irritert; ettergivende, villig til å tåle overgrep.

Blir vi irriterte hvis noen har noe å dele med oss som kan hjelpe oss i vår vandring med Herren? Husk at vår Herre ønsker frukten av mildhet pynte våre omvendte liv.

Quiet: stille; være i hviletilstand; ikke i bevegelse; fredelig; ikke urolig; ikke støtende; ikke skape strid, uorden eller trøbbel; mild; mild; fornøyd.

Ved hver ny stil som kommer blant oss, er vi raske til å endre oss uten grunn annet enn å legge noe til våre kropper som bare gir oss ære? Er vi fornøyde med Guds bibelske norm for våre liv? Står vi fast og er grunnfestet i det vi tror? Vet vi hvorfor vi tror det vi tror?

Subjection: handlingen å underkue; handlingen å beseire og bringe under en annens herredømme.

Er vi under vår Herres herredømme i alle aspekter av våre liv?

Afraid: preget av frykt eller engstelse.

Amazement: forbauselse; forvirring eller forlegenhet fra et plutselig inntrykk av frykt, overraskelse eller undring.

Vi er døtre av Sara så lenge vi gjør godt og ikke blir preget av frykt eller noen forvirring eller forlegenhet. Gud er ikke forvirrelsens opphav—Herrens lov er fullkommen, den gir sjelen nytt liv… – Salme 19:7. Husk: Frykt for Herren er begynnelsen til visdom [ikke forvirring]… – Ordspråkene 9:10.

Entangleth: å vri eller sammenflette på en slik måte at det ikke lett lar seg skille; å forvirre eller distrahere, som med bekymringer.

Lar vi våre liv bli sammenvevd med denne verdens moter og dårskap?

Ingen som fører krig legger seg inn i verdslige sysler; for at han som har calt ham til å være soldat, skal få behage ham. Hold dere borte fra tomme og verdenselige prat: for det fører til mer gudløshet. Fly også fra ungdommens lyster; og følg rettferdighet, tro, kjærlighet, fred, sammen med dem som kaller på Herren av et rent hjerte – 2 Timoteus 2:4-22.

Shun: å unngå; holde seg unna; ikke komme borti; ikke blande seg med eller omgås.

Holder vi oss unna denne verdens praksiser? Mer spesifikt, unngår vi løs og tom prat?

Profane: vanhellig mot noe hellig; forurenset; ikke ren.

Vain: tom; verdiløs; uten substans, verdi eller betydning.

Det vi fyller oss med vil komme ut. Hvis vi fyller oss med Guds hellige Ord, vil det flyte ut av våre liv. Men hvis vi fyller oss med tomme ting, vil også det komme ut.

Babblings: tåpelig prat.

Er vår prat sentrert rundt Bibelen, eller er den sentrert rundt de nye tingene vi har kjøpt som et nytt plagg eller et kjøretøy, eller kanskje alt personene vi har møtt på Facebook?

Flee: å rømme med hurtighet, som fra fare; å skynde seg bort fra fare eller forventet ondt.

Hvis vi er i en gruppe mennesker hvis prat er tåpelig, blir vi da værende av frykt for å miste venner, eller går vi (eller løper) bort fra den forventede eller farlige ondskap? Jo mer vi sammenfletter våre liv med verdens måter, desto vanskeligere blir det å komme løs.

Lusts: lengselsfullt begjær; iver etter å eie eller nyte; kjødelig appetitt; ulovlig begjær etter kjødelig lyst.

Gud vil gi oss de sanne ønskene i vårt hjerte. Vi kan si at vi begjærer rene ting, men hvis vårt hjerte lengter etter ulovlige ting, vil vi overgi oss til de tingene. Vårt liv består ikke bare i det vi sier, men viktigere i det vi lever. Ta også mot til dere; de indre ønskene i vårt hjerte kan forandres for alltid gjennom den åndelige virkning eller «nyfødsel».

Righteousness: Kristi aktive og passive lydighet, ved hvilken Guds lov blir oppfylt.

Hvis vi skal følge rettferdighet, betyr det at vi bør følge den aktive og passive lydighet som Kristus viser oss ved sitt eksempel.

Faith: gjenstand for tro; en lære eller system av doktriner som det tror på.

Hva er realiteten i vår tro? Tror vi virkelig Gud og det Han forteller oss gjennom sitt skrevne Ord? Det var fordi Abraham trodde Gud at han var i stand til å «ofre» sin eneste sønn Isak, gjennom hvem Abrahams etterkommere ville bli talt. – se Hebreerne 11:17 og 1 Mosebok 22:13. Hvis Gud forteller oss i sitt Ord å unngå gudløshet fordi det fører til mer gudløshet, må vi tro Gud og flykte fra disse tingene, og vi må ikke tillate oss å tenke at bare litt moro ikke vil ha betydning.

Charity: kjærlighet; velvilje; godvilje; den holdning i hjertet som får mennesker til å tenke vel om sine medmennesker og gjøre dem godt; det inkluderer høyeste kjærlighet til Gud, vår Skaper, og universell velvilje mot mennesker.

Har vi Guds kjærlighet som bor i oss og flyter ut av våre liv som en kilde med rennende vann?

Peace: himmelsk hvile; harmoni; frihet fra forstyrrelse eller uro.

Vi skal følge eksempelet til vår kjære Frelser Jesus Kristus, hvis hele liv var i perfekt harmoni med Gud Faderen. Kristus ble ikke forstyrret eller opprørt av denne verdens måter, men Han hvilte i å gjøre sin Faders vilje. Er vi det?

Pure: klar; fri fra moralsk besmittelse; uten flekk; hellig; ukorrumpert.

Vi skal ha disse fruktene pryde våre liv og også praktisere disse sammen med dem som praktiserer de samme tingene i sine liv. En liten surdeig syrner hele deigen.

På samme måte skal kvinnene prydes i edruelig kledning, med skamfullhet og beskjedenhet; ikke med flettet hår, eller gull, eller perler, eller kostbare drakter; men (det som passer kvinner som bekjenner gudsfrykt) med gode gjerninger – 1 Timoteus 2:9-10.

Shamefacedness: sjenanse; overdrevent beskjedenhet.

Vi bør være prydet med skamfullhet og ikke med lettsindighet eller sanselighet.

Sobriety: vanemessig edruelighet; alvor; verdighet uten tristhet eller melankoli.

Selv om vi er edruelige, trenger vi ikke være triste, men vi kan ha Herrens glede pryde våre liv. Det bør være et lys i våre øyne fordi Jesus er lyset i våre liv. Virkelig, hvis Guds ånd bor i oss, har vi så mye å være takknemlige for. Det bør være synlig i alle aspekter av våre liv.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

For Guds nåde som bringer frelse for alle mennesker, er blitt åpenbart. Den lærer oss å fornekte ugudelighet og verdslige lyster, og å leve edruelig, rettferdig og gudfryktig i denne verden – Titus 2:11-12.

Jeg vil glede meg storlig i Herren, min sjel skal fryde seg i min Gud; for han har kledd meg i frelsens klær, han har ikledd meg rettferdighetens kappe, som en brudgom pryder seg med smykker, og som en brud pryder seg med sine perler – Jesaja 61:10.

Prydene av beskjedenhet, skamfullhet, edruelighet, tro, kjærlighet, fred, rettferdighet, mildhet og stillhet er virkelig perler av stor verdi. Disse perlene er så dyrebare at det er verdt å overgi hele vårt liv til himmelens Gud, vår Skaper og vår Frelser, slik at vi kan ha dem pryde våre liv. Men på samme måte, hvis vi er overgitt til denne verdens gud, vil vi ha pryder av stolthet, misunnelse, hat, sjalusi og så videre. Hvilke av dem er de vakreste?

Og jeg Johannes så den hellige byen, det nye Jerusalem, komme ned fra Gud fra himmelen, ferdig som en brud som er prydet for sin mann. Og jeg hørte en høy røst fra himmelen si: Se, Guds bolig er hos menneskene; og han skal bo hos dem, og de skal være hans folk, og Gud selv skal være hos dem og være deres Gud – Åpenbaringen 21:2-3.

Forbereder vi oss på å møte Jesus? Bor Gud i oss? Er Han vår Gud og er vi Hans folk?

Husk at tiden går raskt. Vi kan være her i dag og borte i morgen. Vil vi være hos Jesus i all evighet, eller vil vi være hos djevelen og hans engler? Valgene vi gjør for våre liv i dag vil påvirke hvor vi tilbringer evigheten.

Bli ikke villedet; Gud lar seg ikke spotte: for hva et menneske sår, det skal han også høste – Galaterne 6:7. La dere ikke lede feil. Den verset gjelder også den troende, ikke bare den uomvendte. Hver av oss kan spørre oss hva vi sår. Når det gjelder pyntelse, sår vi tanken om at ytre skjønnhet er veldig viktig, eller sår vi tanken om at indre skjønnhet er det mest dyrebare å ha og oppnå? For klarhetens skyld snakker jeg ikke om å være skitten og usminket. Gud er en Gud av orden og renhet, men Han er ikke en Gud av bånd, sløyfer, volanger, blonder og dyre, attraktive klær. Husk at de fleste som skaper nye klesmoter fokuserer på å designe plagg slik at de skal være appellerende og tiltrekkende for øyet. Det er det som får folk til å kjøpe dem.

Igen, når folk ser på oss, priser de da vårt legemlige legeme eller priser de Gud for det verket Han gjør i våre liv? Også når det gjelder dårskap og løsaktighet, hvis vi er grunnfestet i Guds ord, vil vi ikke ha tid til tom prat og lystsøkende idling. La oss være opptatt med å gjøre vår Herres verk, som å hjelpe vår neste som kunne trenge en ekstra hånd, eller dele vårt vitnesbyrd med mennesker vi møter.

Og frykt ikke dem som dreper legemet, men som ikke kan drepe sjelen; men frykt heller ham som kan fortære både sjel og legeme i helvete – Matteus 10:28. Når vi lever i disse siste tider, er budskapet rundt oss at så lenge du tror på en Gud, vil du være greit. Det er et falskt budskap. Jesus sier at det bare finnes én vei. Jesus sier til ham: Jeg er veien, sannheten og livet; ingen kommer til Faderen uten ved meg. Hadde dere kjent meg, hadde dere også kjent min Far; og fra nå av kjenner dere ham og har sett ham – Johannes 14:6-7. Pris Herren for at Gud har gitt oss et forbilde å følge.

Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created –Revelation 4:11.

This hymn, often called the “National Anthem of Christendom,” is perhaps one of the greatest of hymns of all time. It was written by Edward Perronet, first appearing in the November 1779 issue of Gospel Magazine. It was edited by Augustus Toplady, who is also the author of another well-known hymn, “Rock of Ages”. The text of this hymn, All Hail the Power of Jesus Name, has been translated into almost every language where Christianity is known. Wherever it is sung, it communicates to the spiritual needs of human hearts. One writer has said, “So long as there are Christians on earth, it will continue to be sung; and after that, in heaven.”

Edward Perronet was born at Sundridge, Kent, England, in 1726. He was a descendant of a distinguished French Huguenot family who had fled to Switzerland and later to England because of the religious persecution in France. Edward’s father, a pastor in the State Church of England, was strongly sympathetic with the evangelical movement spearheaded by the Wesleys and George Whitefield. Edward, too, like his father, became a minister in the Anglican Church but was always critical of its ways. Once he wrote, “I was born and I am likely to die in the tottering communion of the Church of England, but I despise her nonsense.” Soon, however, he broke from the Church and threw himself strenuously into the evangelistic endeavors of the Wesleys during the 1740s and 1750s.

Charles Wesley writes of Edward Perronet’s boldness in preaching. At one time he and Perronet were beset in a house by a mob of rough revilers, whom Perronet opposed courageously, while they abused him and threw dirt on him. It was during this time that the Wesleys and their followers suffered much persecution and even violence from those who disagreed with their ministry. Concerning these experiences, Wesley made the following notation in his diary: “From Rockdale we went to Bolton, and soon found that the Rockdale lions were lambs in comparison with those of Bolton.” Edward Perronet was thrown down and rolled in mud and mire. Stones were hurled and windows broken.

Another interesting account is given regarding the relationship between the Wesleys and Perronet. John Wesley wanted to hear Perronet preach, and he, being 18 years younger than John had always refused to preach in the older churchman’s presence. So, one day Wesley seeing Edward in the congregation announced that he would preach at the next service. Desiring to avoid a public conflict with Wesley, Perronet mounted the pulpit the next morning, but quickly explained that he had never consented to preach. “However,” he added, “I shall deliver the greatest sermon that has ever been preached on earth.” He then read the Sermon on the Mount and sat down without comment.

After eight years of co-operation with the Wesleys, Perronet’s strong-mindedness and free spirit caused a division between them, as he disagreed with some of their regulations. They continued, however, to esteem and love each other.

The last years of Perronet were spent at Canterbury, where he was pastor of an independent church, and where he died in 1792, at the age of sixty-six. His last words have also become a classic: “Glory to God in the height of His divinity! Glory to God in the depth of His humanity! Glory to God in His all-sufficiency! Into His hands I commend my spirit.”

Though Perronet wrote many other hymns and forms of poetry, none of them, have attained fame except the immortal “All Hail the Power of Jesus Name.” The success of this text has, no doubt, been furthered by three fine tunes. “Coronation,” composed by Oliver Holden, a Massachusetts carpenter, self-taught musician, and respected singing-school teacher, is most widely used in America. “Miles Lane” composed by William Shrubsole, Perronet’s personal friend, is the most popular in Great Britain. While the festive “Diadem” tune, composed in 1838 for this text by James Ellor, an English layman, is frequently used as a choir number. This hymn was originally written having the title, “On the Resurrection,” and there were eight stanzas, as follows:

All hail the power of Jesus’ name,
Let angels prostrate fall
Bring forth the royal diadem,
To crown Him Lord of all!

Let high born seraphs tune the lyre,
And, as they tune it, fall
Before His face who tunes their choir,
And crown Him Lord of all!

Crown Him, ye morning stars of light,
Who fixed this floating ball,
Now hail the Strength of Israel’s might,
And crown Him Lord of all!

Crown Him, ye martyrs of your God,
Who from His altar call;
Extol the stem of Jesse’s rod,
And crown Him Lord of all!

Ye seed of Israel’s chosen race,
Ye ransomed of the fall,
Hail Him who saves you by His grace
And crown Him Lord of all!

Hail Him, ye heirs of David’s line,
Whom David Lord did call.
The God incarnate, Man divine,
And crown Him Lord of all!

Sinners, whose love can ne’er forget
The wormwood and the gall,
Go spread your trophies at His feet,
And crown Him Lord of all!

Let every tribe and every tongue
That bound creation’s call
Now shout in universal song,
The crowned Lord of all!

As it now stands in our hymnbooks, the hymn is shortened and changed, and one stanza has been added by the famous hymn collector, Rev. John Rippon, in 1787.

Oh, that with yonder sacred throng
We at His feet may fall;
We’ll join the everlasting song,
And crown Him Lord of all.

As we wrap up this amazing story of the life of Edward Perronet and the others who have had their part in bringing this immortal hymn to us, let’s take a look in closing at the effect this hymn has had on heathens who knew nothing about Jesus. The most famous story connected with Perronet’s great hymn is told of the missionary to India, Rev. E.P. Scott. One day he saw on the street a man of so strange an appearance that he inquired about him and learned that he belonged to a wild mountain tribe among whom Christ had never been preached. Mr. Scott prayed over the matter and decided to visit that tribe. As soon as he reached their mountain home, he fell in among a savage band of murderous tribesmen who were on a war expedition, and who were closing in on him with their spears. They seized him and pointed their spears at his heart. At once the missionary drew out the violin that he always carried with him and began to play and sing in the native language, “All hail the power of Jesus’ name!” He closed his eyes, expecting death at any minute. When he reached the fourth stanza, and nothing had happened, he opened his eyes, and was amazed to see that the spears had fallen from the hands of the savages, and big tears were in their eyes! They invited Mr. Scott to their homes, and he spent the remaining years of his life preaching and ministering God’s love and redemption to these people. God in His providence used a simple hymn as a means of introducing the gospel to a group of needy pagans.

A Treasury of Hymn Stories
101 Hymn stories

“Miles Lane” Tune -William Shrubsole, 1760-1806
“Diadem” Tune -James Elliot, 1838
“Let Us Crown Him” Tune -James McGranahan 1840-1907

Engkaulah layak, ya Tuhan, menerima kemuliaan dan kehormatan dan kuasa: karena Engkaulah yang telah menciptakan segala sesuatu, dan karena kehendak-Mulah segala sesuatu ada dan diciptakan – Wahyu 4:11.

Himne ini, sering disebut “Lagu Kebangsaan Kekristenan,” mungkin salah satu himne terbesar sepanjang masa. Itu ditulis oleh Edward Perronet, pertama kali muncul dalam edisi Gospel Magazine bulan November 1779. Teksnya disunting oleh Augustus Toplady, yang juga penulis himne terkenal lainnya, “Rock of Ages”. Teks himne ini, All Hail the Power of Jesus Name, telah diterjemahkan ke hampir setiap bahasa tempat Kekristenan dikenal. Di manapun dinyanyikan, ia menjawab kebutuhan rohani hati manusia. Seorang penulis pernah berkata, “Selama masih ada orang Kristen di bumi, himne ini akan terus dinyanyikan; dan sesudah itu, di sorga.”

Edward Perronet lahir di Sundridge, Kent, Inggris, pada 1726. Ia adalah keturunan keluarga Huguenot Prancis terkemuka yang melarikan diri ke Swiss dan kemudian ke Inggris karena penganiayaan agama di Prancis. Ayah Edward, seorang pendeta dalam Gereja negara Inggris, sangat simpatik terhadap gerakan evangelis yang dipelopori oleh para Wesley dan George Whitefield. Edward, seperti ayahnya, menjadi seorang pendeta di Gereja Anglikan tetapi selalu mengkritik cara-cara gerejanya. Suatu ketika ia menulis, “Aku dilahirkan dan kemungkinan akan mati dalam persekutuan Gereja Inggris yang goyah, tetapi aku meremehkan kebodohannya.” Tak lama setelah itu, ia memisahkan diri dari Gereja dan terjun penuh dalam usaha-usaha penginjilan para Wesley pada 1740-an dan 1750-an.

Charles Wesley menulis tentang keberanian Edward Perronet dalam berkhotbah. Pada suatu waktu dia dan Perronet diserbu dalam sebuah rumah oleh gerombolan pengejek kasar, yang dengan gagah berani dilawan oleh Perronet, sementara mereka menghina dan melempari tanah kepadanya. Saat itu para Wesley dan pengikutnya mengalami banyak penganiayaan bahkan kekerasan dari mereka yang tidak setuju dengan pelayanan mereka. Mengenai pengalaman-pengalaman ini, Wesley membuat catatan berikut dalam diarinya: “Dari Rockdale kami pergi ke Bolton, dan segera mengetahui bahwa singa-singa Rockdale adalah domba dibandingkan dengan yang di Bolton.” Edward Perronet dilemparkan dan digulingkan dalam lumpur dan kotoran. Batu-batu dilempar dan jendela-jendela dipecahkan.

Cerita menarik lain diberikan mengenai hubungan antara para Wesley dan Perronet. John Wesley ingin mendengar Perronet berkhotbah, dan karena Perronet 18 tahun lebih muda darinya ia selalu menolak berkhotbah di hadapan pria gereja yang lebih tua itu. Jadi, suatu hari Wesley melihat Edward dalam jemaat mengumumkan bahwa ia akan berkhotbah pada kebaktian berikutnya. Berkeinginan menghindari konflik publik dengan Wesley, Perronet naik mimbar keesokan paginya, tetapi segera menjelaskan bahwa ia tidak pernah setuju untuk berkhotbah. “Namun,” tambahnya, “aku akan menyampaikan khotbah terbesar yang pernah disampaikan di dunia.” Ia lalu membaca Khotbah di Bukit dan duduk tanpa komentar.

Setelah delapan tahun bekerja sama dengan para Wesley, keras kepala dan jiwa merdeka Perronet menimbulkan perpecahan di antara mereka, karena ia tidak setuju dengan beberapa peraturan mereka. Namun demikian mereka terus saling menghargai dan saling mengasihi.

Tahun-tahun terakhir Perronet dihabiskan di Canterbury, di mana ia menjadi gembala sebuah gereja independen, dan di sanalah ia meninggal pada 1792, pada usia enam puluh enam tahun. Kata-kata terakhirnya juga menjadi klasik: “Kemuliaan bagi Allah dalam keagungan Keilahian-Nya! Kemuliaan bagi Allah dalam kedalaman kemanusiaan-Nya! Kemuliaan bagi Allah dalam kecukupan-Nya! Kepada tangan-Nyalah kumempercayakan rohku.”

Walaupun Perronet menulis banyak himne dan karya puisi lainnya, tak satu pun selain “All Hail the Power of Jesus’ Name” yang mencapai ketenaran. Keberhasilan teks ini, tak diragukan, dibantu oleh tiga melodi yang baik. “Coronation,” yang digubah oleh Oliver Holden, seorang tukang kayu Massachusetts, musisi otodidak, dan guru sekolah nyanyian yang dihormati, paling banyak digunakan di Amerika. “Miles Lane” yang digubah oleh William Shrubsole, teman pribadi Perronet, paling populer di Inggris Raya. Sementara melodi meriah “Diadem,” yang digubah pada 1838 untuk teks ini oleh James Ellor, seorang awam Inggris, sering digunakan sebagai nomor paduan suara. Himne ini semula ditulis berjudul, “On the Resurrection,” dan ada delapan bait, sebagai berikut:

Hormatlah kepada kuasa nama Yesus,
Biarkan malaikat-malaikat sujud terbenam
Hadirkanlah mahkota kerajaan,
Untuk memahkotai Dia Tuhan atas segala!

Biarkan seraf yang lahir tinggi menyetem kecapi,
Dan, ketika mereka menyetemnya, jatuhlah
Di hadapan wajah Dia yang menyetem paduan suara mereka,
Dan memahkotai Dia Tuhan atas segala!

Mahkotailah Dia, hai bintang-bintang pagi yang bercahaya,
Yang menempatkan bola yang terapung ini,
Kini puji Kekuatan dari kaum Israel,
Dan mahkotai Dia Tuhan atas segala!

Mahkotailah Dia, hai para martir Allahmu,
Yang dari mezbah-Nya memanggil;
Pujilah cabang tongkat Isai,
Dan mahkotai Dia Tuhan atas segala!

Hai keturunan bangsa pilihan Israel,
Hai orang-orang yang ditebus dari kejatuhan,

yang oleh Daud dipanggil sebagai Tuhan.

Seperti yang sekarang tercantum dalam buku himne kita, himne ini dipendekkan dan diubah, dan satu bait telah ditambahkan oleh pengumpul himne terkenal, Rev. John Rippon, pada 1787.

Oh, kiranya bersama kumpulan kudus di sana
Kita di kaki-Nya dapat sujud;
Kita akan bergabung dalam nyanyian kekal,
Dan mahkotai Dia Tuhan atas segala.

Saat kita menutup kisah menakjubkan tentang hidup Edward Perronet dan mereka yang berperan membawa himne abadi ini kepada kita, marilah kita meninjau pada akhir kisah pengaruh himne ini terhadap orang-orang kafir yang tidak tahu apa-apa tentang Yesus. Kisah paling terkenal yang terkait dengan himne besar Perronet diceritakan tentang misionaris ke India, Rev. E.P. Scott. Suatu hari ia melihat di jalan seorang lelaki bertubuh begitu aneh rupa sehingga ia menanyakan tentangnya dan mengetahui bahwa lelaki itu berasal dari suku pegunungan liar di antara mereka Kristus belum pernah diberitakan. Tuan Scott berdoa mengenai hal itu dan memutuskan untuk mengunjungi suku itu. Begitu ia tiba di rumah gunung mereka, ia jatuh di antara segerombolan suku-suku pembunuh yang sedang dalam ekspedisi perang, dan yang mendekatinya dengan tombak-tombak mereka. Mereka menangkapnya dan mengarahkan tombak-tombak mereka ke jantungnya. Seketika misionaris itu mengeluarkan biola yang selalu dibawanya dan mulai memainkan serta menyanyikan dalam bahasa setempat, “All hail the power of Jesus’ name!” Ia menutup matanya, mengharapkan kematian setiap saat. Ketika ia mencapai bait keempat, dan tidak terjadi apa-apa, ia membuka mata, dan terkejut melihat tombak-tombak telah jatuh dari tangan para perampok itu, dan air mata besar mengalir di mata mereka! Mereka mengundang Tuan Scott ke rumah mereka, dan ia menghabiskan sisa hidupnya memberitakan dan melayani kasih serta keselamatan Allah kepada kaum itu. Allah dalam providensi-Nya memakai sebuah himne sederhana sebagai sarana memperkenalkan Injil kepada sekelompok orang pagan yang membutuhkan.

I have enjoyed listening to, and even taking part in, discussions about the Covid shot—about why someone has, and why the other has not, received it. I venture to say we could have seven people give their viewpoint on the subject and maybe have eight different ideas.

I begin with the disclaimer that these are my thoughts, and I am quite okay with someone disagreeing. In fact, I would welcome others to share their viewpoints.

One of the things you will notice in this writing is that I don’t call the Covid shot a ‘vaccine’. Not that it doesn’t technically fit the official definition, but rather that it doesn’t function the way we have known vaccines to work. I remember when I was a lad about four years of age, I went with my mother to the health department and received a vaccination in my upper arm for smallpox. (The pock mark is still there) I remember some years later when the whole community gathered at our local public school for the sugar cube treatment which was an oral vaccination against polio. I don’t remember if I had any other vaccinations or not. My point is that these vaccinations were immunizations against a disease. We were assured that we would not get smallpox, polio, measles or whatever else we were vaccinated for. And we didn’t—not just a lesser amount or a case not as severe. We understood that we were immunized, and the fight was over.

During the current pandemic we kept hearing about the vaccination that was coming. It sounded like this was going to be the answer to this pestilence that had settled on the world. Some of us wondered if this would be like the flu shot that targets certain viruses, while it misses the other flu viruses. As the drama unfolded, we soon began to hear of variants and the need for booster shots. We now know for sure that this shot does not give an immunization for Covid 19, and hence, for clarity it is better to call it a flu shot.

I remember so well farming in the early 90’s and hearing about Roundup-Ready crops. It seemed too good to be true to be able to spray glyphosate (Roundup) over the top of the crop and take out all the weeds while doing no harm to the crop. The manufacturer did keep telling us to spray maximum rates so as to ‘kill’ every weed. Theoretically they were right, if we could have killed every weed, without missing one, we would not have had the next problem—spray-resistant weeds. We didn’t realize how fast our troublesome ‘pigweeds’ (and other weeds) in the south, would mutate and develop a resistance to glyphosate.

Sure, farmers had several good years with an easy way to keep out the weeds, but that didn’t last and now the situation is worse than it was before. Today, every farmer knows about ‘Palmer amaranth Pigweed’. You can almost ‘pour’ glyphosate on it, and still it thrives. These weeds mutated very rapidly and became resistant.

I think we have a similar scenario with the Covid shot. I’m certainly not a scientist but it does seem to me that since the shot admittedly mostly reduces symptoms instead of producing immunity, then it will most likely speed up the mutation of the Covid-19 virus. This seems like the normal ‘struggle for survival’ principle of life.

The rapid speed with which this shot came on the market is another concern. We really don’t know what all it will bring down the road nor the side effects it may cause. We don’t know how many boosters will be called for. It seems the world is the test field at the moment, and from what I’m seeing it is not working too well and many of the people who have had the shot don’t really trust it. The people who have had the virus have built an immunity that is far superior to the protection of the shot. We’ve known since childhood that when we had the flu, our body would build immunity to that strain. This is the way our Maker designed us. One of the first people I personally knew that had Covid was told they would have six months of immunity. I wondered how they figured that out so quickly. This was a new virus, and we had no experience to draw on for this virus. Also, the viruses we were familiar with gave lifetime immunity to that strain. So what science was behind this?

Hence, I think it much better to take precautions and do what we can to boost our immune system. It is an excellent time to remember we are to be stewards of the body that God gave us. It’s a good time to put a plan in place of good nutrition, exercise, and weight loss. If you are overweight, you are much more likely to be affected by this pestilence and many other illnesses. If you regularly consume sugary drinks or unhealthy foods of any kind, it is an excellent time to kick the habit and reduce your sugar consumption. If you are overweight or out of shape physically, there is no better time than now to bring your body into a condition that will be much healthier, so you will be better able to ward off this virus and many other illnesses.

My belief is that in the long run it will be safer and better to do my part and let this body build the immunities to protect itself against this virus. I realize there are those who have died after contracting this illness. I don’t belittle this fact and I am sorry for the loss of life. I do believe too that we as Christians should constantly commit our lives to God and look at the whole picture of life and its preservation through the lens of Christian ethics.

It is unprecedented that an illness with a recovery rate of somewhere around 99%, would cause such a stir, the world over. We know that if it wouldn’t be for the invention of social media there would not have been near the panic and turmoil. One of my greatest concerns is how we are being ‘conditioned’ for more to come. Who would have ever thought that a flu virus would be the instrument that ushers in a global push for something that will be the benchmark for whether we can travel, go to eating places, gather for public events and other such restrictions. It sounds strangely similar to what God says will one day be a reality—And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name –Revelation 13:16-17.

I have been almost ridiculed for even mentioning the mark of the beast. Still others think this passage is to be spiritualized and has nothing to do with the end time system of government. Still others think the bride will be raptured before this, hence nothing for us to be concerned with. I could wish one of these views would be right, then I could move along in silence hoping that all would be well.

I will hasten to say that I don’t think this is the ‘mark of the beast’, but rather I see it as another step closer to that event. I also hasten to say that this is not a writing to ridicule another belief nor is it an effort to try to pull together certain Scriptures to try to support a particular doctrinal agenda such as the idea that all believers will be raptured prior to the unfolding of end time events, thereby escaping what the Bible refers to as “great tribulation”. –See Matthew 24:21 and Revelation 7:14. It’s time we open our eyes to the ‘conditioning’ that our society is having upon us in general, and the conditioning of this shot in particular. There are all kinds of good reasons we will go ahead with it—it makes good sense, it defies science not to, I’ve even heard we can be better witnesses if we have had it, and the list goes on. All the while we are being ‘conditioned’ to do what it takes to keep rolling down our economic road.

So, my plea is that we consider where we are headed. One day God’s people will need to jump off the train of this world—Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you –2 Corinthians 6:17. Revelation 14:10-11 declares that all who take the mark will seal their destiny in hell. The next verse gives a calling for the endurance of the saints—Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus –Revelation 14:12.

There will be hard times—Read Matthew 24:4-28. Consider the famines, pestilences, and earthquakes that are promised will come. Jesus said all these are the beginnings of sorrows—literally birth pangs. He said along with this, ‘the end is not yet’. Yet we have the promise of triumph—And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death –Revelation 12:11. I say again, “One day the saints will need to jump off the economic train.”

I think now is an excellent time to evaluate our attachment, whether it is connected to this world or to our future heavenly reward. Let’s make a commitment anew to identify with our soon coming Lord and King. Also, it’s an excellent time to share the gospel of Jesus’ Kingdom with a society that is bent on going away from the Creator.

So, for now, I’m content to feel safe with the immunity in my body as God created it and I am purposing in a new way to seek the immunity from the ways of sin and evil and to be inoculated with the Holy Ghost from heaven. Will you join me in this commitment?

נהניתי להקשיב, ואף לקחת חלק, בדיונים על הזריקה נגד קוביד—מדוע מישהו קיבל אותה ומדוע מישהו אחר לא קיבל. אתגר לומר שיכולנו לשמוע שבעה אנשים שיתנו את דעתם על הנושא ולקבל אולי שמונה דעות שונות.

אני מתחיל בהכחשה שאלה הן מחשבותיי שלי, ואני לגמרי מוכן שמישהו יחלוק עליהן. למעשה, אשמח שאחרים ישתפו את נקודות מבטם.

אחת מהדברים שתבחינו בהם בכתיבה זו היא שאני לא קורא לזריקת הקוביד "חיסון". לא שהדבר אינו מתאים טכנית להגדרה הרשמית, אלא שהיא אינה מתפקדת כפי שהכרנו חיסונים עובדים. אני זוכר שכילד בערך בגיל ארבע, הלכתי עם אמי למחלקת הבריאות וקיבלתי חיסון בזרוע העליונה נגד אבעבועות רוח. (הצלקת עדיין שם) אני זוכר כמה שנים לאחר מכן כשכל הקהילה התאספה בבית הספר הציבורי שלנו לטיפול על קוביית סוכר שהיה חיסון פומי נגד פוליו. אינני זוכר אם קיבלתי חיסונים אחרים או לא. הנקודה שלי היא שחיסונים אלה היו חיסונים נגד מחלה. הובטח לנו שלא נקבל אבעבועות רוח, פוליו, חצבת או כל דבר אחר שחוסנו נגדו. ולא קיבלנו—לא רק מקרה קל יותר או מקרה פחות חמור. הבנו שאנחנו מחוסנים, והמאבק נגמר.

במהלך המגפה הנוכחית המשכנו לשמוע על החיסון שהולך להגיע. נשמע שזה יהיה הפתרון למגפה שישבה על העולם. חלק מאיתנו תהו אם זה יהיה כמו החיסון לשפעת שמכוון וירוסים מסוימים בעוד הוא מפספס וירוסים שפעתיים אחרים. ככל שהדרמה נפרשה, אנחנו מהר החלו לשמוע על וריאנטים ועל הצורך בחיסוני חיזוק. עכשיו ברור לנו בוודאות שהזריקה הזו אינה נותנת חיסון לקוביד-19, ולכן, למען הבהירות עדיף לקרוא לה חיסון שפעת.

אני זוכר היטב עבודה בחקלאות בתחילת שנות ה-90 ושמועות על גידולים עמידים ל-Roundup. נראה טוב מדי מכדי להיות אמיתי שאפשר לרסס גליפוסאט (Roundup) מעל הצמח ולהשמיד את כל העשבים השוטים מבלי להזיק לתבואה. היצרן המשיך לומר לנו לרסס במינונים מקסימליים כדי "לרצוח" כל עשב יבשתי. תיאורטית הם צדקו—אם היינו יכולים להרוג כל עשב, בלי לפספס אף אחד, לא היינו מקבלים את הבעיה הבאה—עשבים עמידים לריסוס. לא הבנו כמה מהר ה'צמדי חזיר' המטרידים שלנו (ועשבים אחרים) בדרום ישנו את עצמם ויפתחו עמידות לגליפוסאט.

כמובן, החקלאים נהנו כמה שנים טובות עם דרך קלה להרחיק את העשבים, אך זה לא נמשך וכעת המצב גרוע יותר מאשר לפני כן. היום כל חקלאי יודע על ‘Palmer amaranth Pigweed’. אפשר כמעט "להשפך" גליפוסאט עליה, ועדיין היא משגשגת. עשבים אלה עברו מוטציה במהירות רבה והפכו לעמידים.

אני חושב שיש לנו תרחיש דומה עם זריקת הקוביד. אני בהחלט לא מדען, אבל נראה לי שמכיוון שהזריקה, כפי שמקובל להכיר, בעיקר מצמצמת תסמינים במקום ליצור חסינות, אז סביר שתאיץ את המוטציה של נגיף הקוביד-19. זה נראה כמו עיקרון ה'מאבק על הישרדות' הרגיל של החיים.

המהירות שבה הזריקה הוצעה לשוק היא דאגה נוספת. איננו באמת יודעים מה עוד היא תביא בעתיד או אילו תופעות לוואי היא עלולה לגרום. איננו יודעים כמה חיזוקים יידרשו. נראה שהעולם הוא כר הניסוי כעת, ומה שאני רואה זה שאין זה עובד כל כך טוב והרבה מהאנשים שקיבלו את הזריקה אינם באמת סומכים עליה. האנשים שחלו בנגיף בנו חסינות שהיא בהרבה גבוהה יותר מההגנה של הזריקה. ידענו מאז הילדות שכשהיינו חולים בשפעת, גופנו בנה חסינות לזן ההוא. כך הבורא עיצב אותנו. אחד האנשים הראשונים שהכרתי שאישית חלה בקוביד נאמר לו שיהיה לו שישה חודשי חסינות. תהיתי כיצד הם קבעו זאת כל כך מהר. זה היה נגיף חדש ואין לנו ניסיון ללמוד ממנו. כמו כן, הוירוסים שהכרנו העניקו חסינות לכל החיים לזן ההוא. אז איזו מדע היה מאחורי זה?

לפיכך, אני חושב שעדיף לנקוט זהירות ולעשות ככל שנוכל לחזק את המערכת החיסונית שלנו. זה זמן מצוין לזכור שעלינו להיות אוצרים של הגוף שנתן לנו האל. זה זמן טוב להכין תוכנית לתזונה טובה, פעילות גופנית והורדת משקל. אם אתה עודף משקל, הסיכוי שתושפע מהמגפה הזו וממחלות רבות אחרות גבוה יותר. אם אתה צורך באופן קבוע שתייה ממותקת או מזון לא בריא מכל סוג שהוא, זה זמן מצוין להפטר מההרגל ולהפחית את הצריכה של סוכר. אם אתה עודף משקל או מחוץ לכושר פיזי, אין זמן טוב יותר מהווה עכשיו להביא את גופך למצב שיהיה הרבה יותר בריא, כדי שתוכל להדוף את הוירוס הזה ומחלות רבות אחרות טוב יותר.

אמונתי היא שבטווח הארוך יהיה זה בטוח וטוב יותר שאעשה את חלקי ואאפשר לגוף הזה לבנות חסינות שתגנה על עצמו מפני הנגיף הזה. אני מבין שיש אנשים שמתו לאחר שדבקו במחלה הזו. אני לא מזלזל בעובדה הזו ואני מצטער על אובדן החיים. אני גם מאמין שעלינו כמאמינים לנצור את חיינו תמיד לאל ולהסתכל על התמונה הכוללת של החיים ושימורם דרך עדשת האתיקה הנוצרית.

זה חסר תקדים שמחלה עם שיעור החלמה הנע סביב 99% תגרום לכזו סערה ברחבי העולם. אנו יודעים שאם לא הייתה המצאת המדיה החברתית לא הייתה כמעט הפאניקה והסערה. אחת הדאגות הגדולות שלי היא כיצד אנו עוברים 'התניה' לעוד מה שיבוא. מי היה מאמין שווירוס שפעת יהיה הכלי שימשיך דחיפה עולמית למשהו שיהיה הקריטריון אם נוכל לנסוע, ללכת למקומות אכילה, להתכנס לאירועים ציבוריים ומגבלות דומות. זה נשמע באופן מוזר דומה למה שאלוהים אומר שיהיה יום אחד—And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name –Revelation 13:16-17.

כמעט הושמתי בבוז על אף שהזכרתי את חותם החיה. יש מי שחושב שיש להא דזו פסוק להתעברות ולרוחני ושאין לו קשר למערכת הממשלתית של אחרית הימים. יש שעוד חושבים שהכלה תורגם לפני כן, ולכן אין לנו מה לדאוג. הייתי שמח שאחד מהדעות האלה היה נכון, ואז יכולתי ההמשיך בשתיקה בתקווה שהכול בסדר.

אמהר ואומר שאינני סבור כי זוהי ה'חותם של החיה', אלא שאני רואה אותה כעוד צעד קרוב יותר לאותו אירוע. ארוץ ואומר שזה אינו כתיבה ללעג אמונה אחרת ולא ניסיון לרתום פסוקים מסוימים כדי לתמוך באג'נדה דוקטרינלית מסוימת כמו הרעיון שכל המאמינים יתפסו לפני ההתגלות של אירועי אחרית הימים, ובכך יתחמקו ממה שהמקרא מכנה "צרה גדולה". –See Matthew 24:21 and Revelation 7:14. הגיע הזמן שנפתח את עינינו ל'התניה' שהחברה שלנו מפעילה עלינו בכלל, ולהתניה של הזריקה בפרט. יש כל מיני סיבות טובות שנמשיך עם זה—זה הגיוני, זה מתנגד למדע שלא לעשות זאת, שמעתי אפילו שנוכל להיות עדים טובים יותר אם קיבלנו אותה, והרשימה ממשיכה. כל הזמן אנחנו עוברים 'התניה' לעשות את מה שצריך כדי להמשיך לגלגל את הרכבת הכלכלית שלנו.

אז, תפילתי היא שנשקול לאן אנחנו צועדים. יום אחד עם ה'עמך' יצטרכו לקפוץ מהאונייה של העולם—Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you –2 Corinthians 6:17. התגלות 14:10-11 מצהירה שכל שלוקח את החותם יסגור את גורלו לגיהנום. הפסוק הבא קורא לעמידות הקדושים—Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus –Revelation 14:12.

יהיו זמנים קשים—Read Matthew 24:4-28. שקלו את הרעב, המגפות והרעידות אדמה שהובטחו לבוא. ישוע אמר שכל אלה הם תחילת המצוקה—מילולית צירי לידה. הוא אמר יחד עם זאת, 'הסוף עדיין לא הגיע'. אך יש לנו את הבטחת הניצחון—And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death –Revelation 12:11. אני אומר שוב, "יום אחד הקדושים יצטרכו לקפוץ מהקרון הכלכלי."

אני חושב שעכשיו זה זמן מצוין להעריך את ההיקשרות שלנו, בין אם היא קשורה לעולם הזה או לשכרנו השמי העתידי. בואו נעשה מחויבות חדשה לזהות עם אדוננו ומלכנו הקרב לבוא. כמו כן, זה זמן מצוין לחלוק את הבשורה של ממלכתו של ישוע עם חברה שמוטה להתרחק מן הבריאה.

אז, לעת עתה, אני שבע רצון להרגיש בטוח עם החסינות בגופי כפי שאלוהים יצרנו ואני שואף בדרך חדשה לבקש חסינות מדרכי החטא והרוע ולהתחסן בקדוש רוח השמיים. האם תצטרף אלי במחויבות זו?
